# This competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak.
This is the 2020 edition of the annual Indiana competition. This competition will be held over 3 days at the Grand Wayne Convention Center. Competitors do not need to come on Friday if they are not competing in Friday events. Those who wish to apply to be on the competition staff may do so here: https://forms.gle/egjfWQSGxKFJSbEq7
